mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LOG_OUTBOX ( LOG_TYPE , PAYLOAD , STATUS , RETRY_COUNT , AVAILABLE_DT , INS_DT ) VALUES ( #{logType} , #{payload} , 'PENDING' , 0 , NOW() , NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT LOG_OUTBOX_SEQ FROM TB_LOG_OUTBOX WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING' AND RETRY_COUNT < #{maxRetryCount} AND AVAILABLE_DT <= NOW() ORDER BY LOG_OUTBOX_SEQ LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LOG_OUTBOX SET STATUS = 'PROCESSING' , PROCESSING_DT = NOW() , UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE LOG_OUTBOX_SEQ = #{outboxSeq} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT LOG_OUTBOX_SEQ AS logOutboxSeq , LOG_TYPE AS logType , PAYLOAD AS payload , STATUS AS status , RETRY_COUNT AS retryCount FROM TB_LOG_OUTBOX WHERE LOG_OUTBOX_SEQ = #{outboxSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_LOG_OUTBOX SET STATUS = 'COMPLETED' , PROCESSED_DT = NOW() , LAST_ERROR = NULL , UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE LOG_OUTBOX_SEQ = #{outboxSeq} AND STATUS = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE TB_LOG_OUTBOX SET RETRY_COUNT = RETRY_COUNT + 1 , STATUS = CASE WHEN RETRY_COUNT + 1 >= #{maxRetryCount} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END , AVAILABLE_DT = CASE WHEN RETRY_COUNT + 1 >= #{maxRetryCount} THEN AVAILABLE_DT ELSE DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 SECOND) END , PROCESSING_DT = NULL , LAST_ERROR = #{errorMessage} , UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE LOG_OUTBOX_SEQ = #{outboxSeq} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_LOG_OUTBOX WHERE STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND PROCESSED_DT < TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, -#{retentionDays}, NOW())
